title: Axon Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Summon, Macro & Auto Trait Reroll
features:
Axon Hub for Anime Vanguards combines Auto Farm, Smart Auto Play, Macro recording, Auto Summon, and Auto Trait Reroll in one hub. Automate stage runs, configure your unit placement, progress through uncleared stages, and manage your team with customizable farming controls.

⚔️ AUTO FARM & SMART AUTO PLAY

- Auto Play handles unit placement, upgrades, and match management.
- Auto Place with Smart, Max Coverage, Near Spawn, Middle, and Near Base layouts.
- Choose which team slots to deploy.
- Prioritize farming units during your selected waves.
- Auto Upgrade with Balanced, Focus Strongest Unit, and other strategies.
- Set priority slots, upgrade limits, and a minimum Yen reserve.
- Auto Use Abilities with an optional boss-only setting.
- Auto Start and Auto Skip Waves.

🗺️ AUTO PROGRESSION & STAGE FARMING

- Auto Join your selected mode, stage, act, and difficulty.
- Story, Legend Stages, Raids, Dungeons, Challenges, and Elemental Towers.
- Auto Progression selects uncleared stages and advances after each win.
- Optional Nightmare progression after completing Normal.
- Farm a selected stage or replay the last stage when progression finishes.
- Configure Auto Next, Auto Retry, or Return to Lobby after matches.
- Automatically select modifiers and reward choices.

📋 MACRO RECORDING & REPLAY

- Record unit placements, upgrades, selling, and ability usage.
- Replay saved macros with configurable action delays.
- Follow recorded waves for wave-based playback.
- Bind different macros to specific stages.
- Let Auto Play take over after a macro finishes.
- Import and export macros to share your setups.

🎲 AUTO SUMMON & UNIT TARGETING

- Auto Summon with banner selection.
- Choose single summons or ten-pulls.
- Target a wanted unit and automatically find its banner.
- Stop when the target is obtained, with an optional stop on any shiny.
- Configure maximum rolls and a minimum currency reserve.
- Automatically lock pulls by rarity and protect shiny units.
- Send selected summon results to your Discord webhook.

✨ AUTO TRAIT & STAT REROLL

- Auto Trait Reroll targets your selected traits, including Monarch.
- Stop on a wanted trait, resource depletion, or your reroll limit.
- Auto Stat Reroll for Damage, SPA, Range, or all stats.
- Choose a minimum stat tier and maximum reroll count.
- Auto Sell unwanted unit rarities with shiny and trait protection.

🎁 REWARDS & EXTRA TOOLS

- Auto Claim available quests, daily rewards, passes, mail, and achievements.
- Auto Use selected inventory items.
- Discord match-result notifications with optional rewards and unit stats.
- Anti-AFK, Auto Rejoin, and Auto Execute after teleport.
- Low Graphics, Disable 3D Rendering, and FPS controls.
- Import and export configurations.
